title: TEC TAVAKKAL Montessori 7 in 1 Baby Sensory Toy for Kids - Educational Learning Shape Sorter, Activity Stacking, Interactive Fine Motor Skill Development - Multicolor
bullets: 【7 in 1 Montessori Toys】This multifunction sensory activity cube combines 7 different activities in 1, 7 different ways to learn and paly: sensory box, shape sorter, pull strings, shake jingle bells, musical xylophone, bead maze, spinning gears, sorting stacking blocks. The multi-play center is a great Montessori toys for 6 to 12 18 months baby to keep busy and develop toddlers gross motor skill, hand-eye coordination, sensory exploration, shape & color cognition and grasping ability.

【Different Fine Motor Level】This Montessori toys are designed for 1-2 year old boys and girls, it has 3 different challenge level to exercise babies grip and motor skill ability from easy to difficult. Pull string for 6 12 months to develop grip, bead maze, spinning gears, matching blocks fit for 12 -18 months, stacking blocks for 18 24 36 months, different levels will promote your baby's hand eye coordination and fine motor skills. This deserved toy can accompany your babies to grow up.

【Tactile Perception Training Toys】The activity toys have 3 soft strings with different textures and shapes, toddlers have to use different amount of strength to pull the individual cords, from side to side to hear and feel the various sounds and vibrations the cords make, it does not only bring rich tactile experience, but also strengthen babies 3 6 9 months hand muscles and motor skills. Multi-texture shape sorters, shake it to make a sound, allowing babies to have more sensory fun.

【Safety Design & Premium Material】This baby shape sorting activity center is made of BPA-Free ABS material, meet US and EU Toys Standard. No choking hazards, smooth edges on every edge. The colorful elastic bands and 3 pull strings are very soft, will not hurt the baby's hands during the pulling process. The sorter blocks are large enough for baby's 6 to18 months little hands to carry.
